description: Implications apply to emitted tokens only: not to a constituent's tags, the value of a term or a classifier's classes. So the conditions hold, and the node of word lacks m, which its token carries (engine §11).
grammar:
%classifier lex
  "mi" ∈ A
%implies A ⟹ ~m
%rule text [word] ...
%rule word $w(W) <classify(phonemes($w), lex)>
%conditions
  ~m ⊈ classify(phonemes($w), lex),
  ~m ⊈ A ∪ tags($w)
%emits
  $
